newOriginalCodeBoundaries.method: Self-audit of unchanged original routines with declared RAM inputs and I/O shadows. No natural-play or exhaustive semantic certification.

newNativeControlled.method: Controlled native VICE 3.13.2 PAL. Original extracted code restored for every case before declared patches; all cases use unchanged code. Declared RAM/register inputs, IRQ masked, decimal clear, no gameplay route claimed. Two stable PC reads and paused status precede writes; stopping checkpoint confirms completion. CPU and VICE result regions compared, color RAM masked to four bits.

freshNativeClock.method: Restore stable-01; neutral joystick; no RAM/register edits. Non-stopping checkpoints distinguish all IRQ entries from actual game-state services. Checked frame advances.
freshNativeClock.note: Later death disables bonus timing; the enabled counter does not advance on every raw interrupt entry.

publishedContentConsistency.method: Mechanical consistency checks supplement manual reading; resolving a source address does not validate its interpretation. Explicit links checked against the chosen image, including interior bytes and named runtime fields.
